name: High Country Orchard
description: A family-run orchard in Colbert, WA, High Country Orchard grows Peaches, Nectarines, Apricots, Plums, and Cherries. The orchard is busiest in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Sep in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
